name: Cleethorpes Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at St Peter's Church. Open Tue and Thu for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: North East Lincolnshire Council Allotments
short_description: NE Lincolnshire Council allotment sites in Cleethorpes area
image: and Cleethorpes. Plots from £30/year. Waiting lists available. Includes water access and tool storage.

name: Cleethorpes Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at King George V Playing Field
description: Volunteer-run community garden with raised beds and polytunnel. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Open weekends during growing season.
